$description: Notch design tokens. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the design system. Edit this file, then run `python3 design/tokens/generate.py` to regenerate Swift and CSS. CI fails if they drift (see .github/workflows/ci.yml). Format is W3C DTCG, importable into Figma via Tokens Studio.

_meta.contrastPolicy: Every text-on-surface pair below carries its measured WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio. Text tokens meet AA (4.5:1) at body size; tokens that do not are named and scoped explicitly.
_meta.colourBudget: Tier metals are the only saturated colour in the product. Semantic colours are rationed to state, safety, and destruction. See docs/design/01-tokens.md.

dark.$description: Default theme. Warm graphite ramp (hue ~30 degrees, very low saturation) rather than neutral-cool — see ADR 0011 for why.

surfaceRaised.$description: Elevated card on a card. Elevation on dark is a lightness step plus a hairline, never a shadow — shadows do not read on near-black.

surfaceSunken.$description: Inset wells: chart backgrounds, input fields.

textSecondary.$description: Supporting copy, units, axis labels. 7.8:1 on canvas — AA at body size.

textTertiary.$description: Least-emphasis labels. 5.3:1 on canvas, 4.9:1 on surface — AA at body size on both. Deliberately NOT darker: a tertiary token that fails AA gets used for real content eventually. The first draft (#837D73) passed on canvas and failed on surface at 4.43:1 — generate.py caught it.

textDisabled.$description: 3.0:1 — DISABLED CONTROLS ONLY. Never for content. WCAG exempts disabled controls; nothing else may use this.

accent.$description: The single accent. Cool blue on warm ground — a deliberate tension. 7.7:1 on canvas. Used for interactive affordance only, never for data.

accentSubtle.$description: Tinted surface behind selected rows and accent chips.

positive.$description: Jade. 'Inside your band', 'synced'. NEVER used to reward faster weight loss (safety §10 / rate ceiling).

safety.$description: RESERVED for §10 safety interventions: calorie floor breach, unsafe goal weight, rate-of-loss ceiling. Named 'safety', not 'warning', so its scope cannot creep.

critical.$description: Destructive confirmation and hard safety blocks ONLY. There is deliberately no 'error' colour for logged intake — going over your band is not an error. See docs/design/00-design-principles.md.

chartLine.$description: The weight trend line (the 7-day EWMA). Primary data gets the primary text colour, not the accent.

chartBaseline.$description: The 'you, four weeks ago' reference line. Present on every chart — the thesis rendered as a gridline.

chartBand.$description: Target band fill. Wide, soft, unmistakably a range.

chartRaw.$description: Raw daily weight dots. Faint by design, off by default (§1.5).

light.$description: Full parity, built from day one. Metals are darkened to stay legible on a light ground; the notch count carries tier identity either way (ADR 0012).

surfaceRaised.$description: Same fill as surface; elevation on light comes from the shadow token, not a lightness step.

tier.$description: The only saturated colour in the product (ADR 0011). Colour is the SECONDARY signal — notch count is primary (ADR 0012), which is what makes Silver/Platinum and Platinum/Diamond distinguishable at all, and what makes the ladder legible without colour vision.

type.$description: Every style maps to an iOS text style so Dynamic Type works without extra code — non-negotiable for a health app. Sizes are the default (Large) sizes; they scale. Metric styles use tabular figures so digits do not jitter as values change.

$extensions.notch.usage: Onboarding step headings, rank tier name.
Food name in a row, card titles.
Brand and portion under a food name.
The composite score on the rank screen. One per screen, maximum.

space.$description: 4-point grid, with a 2 for optical hairline gaps. If a value you need is not here, the layout is probably wrong.

lg.$description: Default screen gutter and card padding.

vast.$description: Above the hero metric on the rank screen. Whitespace is the drama budget.

radius.$description: Always paired with iOS continuous corner curve — the generated Swift helper applies style: .continuous so it cannot be forgotten.

focus.$description: Keyboard/VoiceOver focus ring. Always visible, never removed.

motion.$description: MOTION BUDGET: nothing except the weekly rank reveal may exceed 0.3s. Enforced by review, not by code — the token names make a violation obvious in a diff. All motion must be gated on the Reduce Motion accessibility setting.

base.$description: Sheet present, tab change. The ceiling for everything routine.

reveal.$description: THE RANK REVEAL, and nothing else. This is the retention moment (§2.2) and the only place the app is allowed to be theatrical.

$extensions.notch.note: Slight overshoot. Deliberate — this is the one place a bounce is earned.

elevation.$description: Dark mode has no shadows; elevation is a surface lightness step plus a hairline stroke. Light mode uses real shadows. The generated Swift helper picks the right treatment per colour scheme so a view cannot get it wrong.

_variants.$description: Not generated. Kept for one-line reversal of the ADR 0011 warmth decision if the warm ramp reads badly on a real device.
